text_block_list.text:
On the morning of the race, every news
outlet is
reporting on a single topic.

"Narita Brian Wins Derby, Closes in on
Triple
Crown."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's the same story everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We can't let her steal all the thunder.
Well, I
guess I'll have my chance soon
enough.
choice_data_list: It's completely all about Narita B...

text_block_list.text: Flash! Flash!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the Takarazuka Kinen press

conference. Please raise your hand if
you'd like to
ask a question.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Yes! Over here, please!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Second row from the front, fourth seat
in. Go
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hello, I'm with the Daily Turf. Narita
Brian took home her second crown the
other day. Can you tell us how you feel
about your younger sister's recent
successes?
Chatter, chatter...

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
We'd like to ask you to please limit your

questions to those concerning the
Takarazuka
Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's all right. I can take this one. I was
expecting
to get this question.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen is where the best
senior Umamusume showcase their skills.
I want you all
to know that I'll be taking
home first.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm here not only to set the stage to
compete against my sister—I'm here to
rise through the
ranks and become the
best of my generation.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
Wait, can it be?
So, she really plans to...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I will beat Narita Brian within the year.
Chatter, murmur...

Biwa Hayahide sets the press room on
fire with
that declaration.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I need you to change tomorrow's
headline!
Yeah, Hayahide just dropped a
bombshell!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Miss Hayahide! Would you
mind going
into more detail about what
you just said?

All eyes are on Biwa Hayahide as she
completely
steals the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I didn't expect the press conference to
run so
late...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But I'm glad I was able to say everything
I had to say. All that's left is for me to
put everything out
there at the
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Anything less than first place
isn't
going to cut it this time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do some light exercise to
round out
the night. Don't worry—I won't
overwork myself.

Biwa Hayahide dashes off, the very
picture of
quiet confidence. It's amazing
how strong she's
become.

There are still a few things left to do
before she
can take on the Takarazuka
Kinen in the best
shape possible.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Excuse me, do you happen to be
Biwa
Hayahide's trainer by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this is great! Do you have a
moment right
now? If you don't mind, I'd
love to interview—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, may I join in as well? Perhaps
we
could do a joint interview!

Even though the press conference is
supposed to be over, the reporters
bombard us with questions
well into the
night.

But they must've done their research.
They're
bound to have a ton of
information on the other
runners.

I turn on my computer to start putting
together
Biwa Hayahide's training
schedule.
choice_data_list: (...I'll make sure to use this dat...

text_block_list.text: Whirrr...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian has taken the lead! Her
opponents may be the finest racers out
there, but she's not
giving up her spot,
folks!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And she's still pulling away! Look at that
 unbelievable speed! She's done it! She's
won the
Japanese Derby, and she made
it look easy!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Bri-an! Bri-an! Bri-an!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Listen to that crowd! Here she is—Narita
Brian, a
beast of a runner and the
greatest Umamusume of
all time!

A video of Narita Brian's performance at
the
Japanese Derby plays on my screen.

Her rate of improvement is
uncanny—scary even.
It's unbelievable
how she manages to keep
getting better.
